Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty overcame World No.1 Takuro Hoki and Yugo Kobayashi of Japan in straight games 23-21, 21-18 to enter the semi-finals.
Relive that high-octane quarter-final clash and tell us your best moment of this match.
